rows.name: LG OLED77B65LA 77 Zoll OLED TV, 4K, webOS
rows.basis: Failure reports show processor failures as early as 6 weeks and power supply issues at 12–24 weeks. Panel uniformity issues appear after 18 weeks. These early failures suggest a low end of 5 years. However, LG is a well-established brand with strong support, many retail outlets, and extensive user reviews (though not provided here), which supports a mid to high life of 8–12 years. The 6-week processor failures are concerning but may reflect early batch issues or rare edge cases. Overall, life is pulled down to 5 years due to multiple early failures, but longer life is plausible with proper use and maintenance.

data.headline: Exact model unproven; B-series failure reports need confirmation

reasons.text: Official French durability index for this exact model scores 8.0/10 overall, with repairability 8.3 and reliability 7.7. It is self-declared by LG but checked by DGCCRF, making it tier A evidence for durability.

Multiple first-hand and community reports describe processor failures, freezes, and power issues in LG B-series OLED TVs, some as early as 6 weeks. None confirm the exact 2026 OLED77B65LA, so the risk is plausible but unverified for this model.

Only 2 marketplace offers exist on idealo for the exact model, with no independent tests or user reviews. The claimed price of €1799 is below the idealo exact price of €2384, adding uncertainty about the actual offer.
